basic_info.description: Why compromise when you can have it all? Fully detached High Ceiling Spanish Med on 31+ ft wide lot of coveted Cecilia street. Equally wonderful home for gathering/entertaining as for enjoying privacy. 8-block walk to West Portal, panoramic views of the hills & ocean. Top-level primary suite w/ separate nursery/office, massive walk-in closet, multi-shower-head spa w double sinks. Bright picture-windowed living room with fireplace and outlooks to lovely landscaped homes. Abundant bespoke cabinetry, island seating, 8-burner Wolf gas range, double oven, warming drawer, & wine cooler. Parquet floors and discreet powder room completes main level. Split-level sunny two-bedrooms with verdant garden outoooks & spacious bath. High Ceiling Lower level family room, laundry, storage, extra sleeping area and interior access to BIG garage.  1.5 Blocks to Guerra's, Parkside, Aprs-vous, & Safeway. Uphill to GG Heights Park and downhill to GG park. 6-minute drive to Stonestown/Whole Foods, YMCA, St. Cecilia's, Lincoln , Hoover, Waldorf, Lowell, & CAIS. Easy access to transport. 7 Exterior camera All City Alarm system. The dream is real.
